name: Fezola
description: One connector for several mailboxes and chats: Gmail, iCloud and any IMAP mailbox, plus read-only Google Chat and Telegram, with unified search, a daily briefing of what needs a reply and reply drafts saved in the right mailbox; never sends mail on its own. Hosted closed-source service with OAuth 2.1 sign-in, free for 2 sources (the linked repo holds docs and client configs) · [Docs](https://app.fezola.com/en/docs)
